brief.description: A compact bundle of three golden-brown bread pieces partially wrapped in an off-white cloth napkin, tied with one broad simple brown twine band. Bread has broad baked crust planes and visible pale crumb on one end. The open top shows food clearly. Compact rounded rectangle silhouette, three-quarter view. Practical late nineteenth-century laborer lunch, no meat, vegetables, metal, printed label or military emblem.
